topic: Saturn is less dense than water
title: Saturn would float on water

hook.visual: A huge golden ringed planet floating like a beach ball on a calm endless dark ocean at dusk.

styleBible: Photoreal cinematic space documentary look, deep blacks, soft volumetric light, anamorphic lens, vertical 9:16 framing.

clips.narration: Saturn is lighter than water. It would float.
clips.prompt: Photoreal cinematic space documentary look, deep blacks, soft volumetric light, anamorphic lens, vertical 9:16 framing. A huge golden ringed planet floats like a beach ball on a calm endless dark ocean at dusk, rings tilted, gentle ripples spreading across the water. Slow push-in from a low angle, warm rim light on the planet's clouds. Audio: soft ocean waves and a low ambient hum, no speech, no music. No text, no logos, no watermarks.

clips.narration: Its rings are mostly ice. They would float too.
clips.prompt: Photoreal cinematic space documentary look, deep blacks, soft volumetric light, anamorphic lens, vertical 9:16 framing. Static wide shot of the thin bright rings of a ringed planet lying flat on dark glassy water, tiny ice fragments sparkling and drifting apart, a faint mist rising at the horizon. Audio: quiet wind and faint ice crackle, no speech, no music. No text, no logos, no watermarks.

facts.claim: Saturn's average density is below water's
